node.description:
__Class:__ Mage
__Relatives:__ [Park Kyung-Hye](https://anilist.co/character/209396/KyungHye-Park) (Mother), [Seong Jin-Ah](https://anilist.co/character/138791/JinAh-Sung) (Sister), ~![Seong Il-Hwan](https://anilist.co/character/138790/IlHwan-Sung) (Father), [Cha Hae-In](https://anilist.co/character/138789/HaeIn-Cha) (Wife), [Seong Su-Ho](https://anilist.co/character/306654/Suho-Sung) (Son)!~ 
~!__Guild:__ Ahjin Guild (Guild Master)
__Affiliation:__ Korean Hunters Association (helper), White Tiger Guild (helper), Hunters Guild (helper), Knights Guild (helper), Ahjin Guild (Guild Master)!~

Seong Jin-U is known as an infamously weak E-Rank Hunter. He is a humble and benevolent individual who cares deeply for his family and has an ardent desire to become stronger. As a result, he shares a close relationship with his sister and his mother, and rarely wastes an opportunity to refine his skills and gain more power.

~!He becomes an S-Rank hunter after being given a chance to become stronger by the System.!~

__Guild:__ Hunters Guild
__Class:__ Sword Fighter
__Affiliations:__ Jeju Island Raid Party, [Song Chi-Yul](https://anilist.co/character/136073/ChiYul--Song)’s Dojo (Disciple)

Cha Hae-In is the Vice-Guild Master of the Hunters Guild. She is an S rank hunter and the 9th ranked hunter in South Korea. She possesses the unique ability of mana smell and hates the smell of hunters except for [Sung Jin-Woo](https://anilist.co/character/129928/JinWoo-Sung).

This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work. 

Please add other narrator characters, which were given a visual representation of themselves, separately from this narrator page.

Igris is one of the first Shadows that [Sung Jin-Woo](https://anilist.co/character/129928/Seong-Jin-U) acquired. He was initially protecting an empty throne in an Instant Dungeon where Jin-Woo was doing his Job Quest in the Job Change Quest Dungeon.

After two failed attempts of Shadow Extraction, Sung Jin-Woo convinced him to protect him instead of protecting an Empty throne, obtaining him as a Knight Grade Shadow.

Born from the Ant Queen on Jeju Island, The Ant King becomes the main threat during the Fourth Jeju Island Raid.

~!Single-handedly responsible for the deaths of over 8 of the 16 S-Rank Hunters during the raid.!~ 

~!After being killed by [Sung Jin-U](https://anilist.co/character/129928/Seong-Jin-U), the Ant King was revived as one of his shadow soldiers, and was given him the new name of Beru.!~
Esil Radiru, or Elisa Radiru, is a daughter of the Radiru chief and an Aristocratic Demon found at the S-Rank Demon's Castle Instant Dungeon.
She is a healer with rank B.
[Jin-U](https://anilist.co/character/129928)'s younger sister.
Go Gun-Hee (고건희) is a South Korean S-Rank Hunter and the Chairman of the Korean Hunters Association.

__Class:__ Tanker
__Guild:__ ~!Ahjin Guild (Vice-Guild Master)!~

Yoo Jin-Ho is a D rank hunter and is [Jin-U Seong](https://anilist.co/character/129928/JinWoo-Sung)'s faithful assistant and combat partner.
He is a S rank hunter and master of the White Tiger guild.
An A rank hunter that works for Hunter's association of Korea.
Choi Jong-In is one of the 10 S-Rank Hunters of South Korea. He is also the Guild Master of the Hunters Guild.
Il-Hwan is a muscular middle-aged man with black eyes, shaggy black hair, and slight facial hair. When using his powers or agitated, his eyes glows bright yellow.
A shadow Sung Jin-Woo gained after entering the Red Gate. ~!Before being reawakened as a Shadow he was Chul Kim (김철), an A-Rank Hunter of the White Tiger Guild.!~
Park Hee-Jin (박희진) is a member of White Tiger Guild that Sung Jin-Woo helped when they got stuck inside the Red Gate.

Han Song-I is an E-Rank hunter who quit school after gaining money through the Yoo Jin-Ho and Sung Jin-Woo motley group of party. She is friends with Sung Jin-Ah. She first appeared when Jin-Ah visited Jin-Woo in the hospital but she didn't know him then.
Thomas Andre (트마스 아드레) is one of only 5 National Level Hunters that exist and is considered to be the strongest Tank on Earth. He is also the Guild Master of the Scavenger Guild.

A shadow Sung Jin-Woo gained after entering the Hunters Guild Gate.

~!Tusk is a shadow of Kargalgan, originally a High Orc Shaman defeated by Jinwoo Sung during the Hunters Guild Gate Arc. After being resurrected, Tusk becomes one of Jinwoo's most potent magic users, known for his devastating area-of-effect spells and high intelligence. Even as a Shadow, Tusk kept his powerful abilities and spells, making him just as capable and even stronger than when he was alive.!~
Shadow of an ice bear that Jinwoo encountered during the Red Gate Incident.

Kaisel is a shadow Sung Jin-Woo obtained in the Demon Castle. Kaisel is the shadow of Kaisellin, a Drake/Wyvern that Demon King Baran used as a mount.

Kaisel used to be a mount that the Demon King Baran rode in battle. After Sung Jin-Woo's fight, he looks around and found that Iron already killed Kaisellin, dragging his corpse towards Sung Jin-Woo. After he was extracted, his grade was Knight, which concludes he was at least an A-Rank.

__Magic Type:__ Fire

Korean C-Rank Hunter and kumdo teacher. He is also one of Jinwoo's old friends, having known him since he was a E-Rank Hunter.

Min Byung-Gu was a retired hunter and one of the 10 S-Rank and only S-Rank Healer of South Korea. He was a close friend with the White Tiger's Guild Master Baek Yoon-Ho. He took part in the 4th Jeju Island Reclamation Raid and was a member of the Korean Raid Team tasked with killing the boss of the Jeju Island Gate.

Zhigang Liu is one of the top five National Level Hunters in the world. Zhigang, who originated from China, was hired by the United States Government to aid with the first S-Rank Gate that appeared in the US.

Gina is an A-Rank mage and was one of the Raid Members in Son Ki-Hoon's Party in an A-Ranked Gate. She has long blonde hair and deep red eyes. Her height is average and she has a very attractive body. Gina has a serious personality this can be seen when she answers Son Ki-Hoon's question about if she was responsible for killing one of the High Orcs.
S-Rank Ice Elf and the boss of the Red Gate Dungeon.
Kanae Tawata is a Japanese S-Rank Hunter under the Draw Sword Guild.

A-Rank Mage from the Hunters Guild who specializes in summoning magic.⁣ She is straightforward, very meticulous, and believes that the only way to overcome difficulties is by laying out the known facts.
Japanese S-Rank healer and a member of the Draw Sword Guild.

Park Kyung-He is the mother of Jin-U and Jin-Ah. She was in the hospital because of the Eternal Sleep.

Her sickness served as the primary motivation for Jin-U becoming a hunter alongside his desire to support his sister with the absence of their father.
Goto Ryuji is Japan's strongest S-Ranked Hunter and the Guild Master of Draw Sword Guild, one of the most powerful guilds in Asia.
Korean A-Rank Hunter and a healer serving under the Hunters Guild, assigned to Strike Squad B.
Son Ki-Hoon (손기훈) is the Team Leader of Attack Force B of the Hunters Guild.
Minoru Hoshino (호시노 미노루) is one of Japan's strongest S-Rank Hunters. He is a member of Japan's strongest guild, the Draw Sword Guild led by Goto Ryuji.
Hwang Dong-su is an​ S-class hunter who works for Scavenger's Guild in America.
Atsushi Kumamoto is one of Japan's strongest S-Rank Hunters. He is a member of Japan's most powerful guild, the Draw Sword Guild led by Goto Ryuji.
Korean A-Rank Hunter and a fighter serving under the Hunters Guild, assigned to Strike Squad B.
Hanekawa is a member and official translator of Japan's most powerful Guild, Draw Sword. Despite serving primarily as a translator of Japan's best hunter, Goto Ryuji, she is also an A-Rank Hunter.

Mari Ishida was one of Japans strongest S-Rank Hunters.

~!She was effortlessly killed during the 4th Jeju Island Reclamation Raid.!~
One of Japan's strongest S-Rank Hunters. He took part in the 4th Jeju Island Reclamation Raid.
Ma Dong-Wook (마동욱) is one of the 10 S-Rank hunters of South Korea and the guild master of Fame Guild.
Famous Korean actor, known as Asia's biggest movie star. He is also an A-Rank Hunter.

Former Korean S-Rank Hunter. ~!About one year before the events of the main storyline, Eunseok participated in the 3rd Jeju Island Raid alongside Baek Yoonho and Min Byung-Gyu. Unfortunately, the raid went sideways and Eunseok was killed under unknown circumstances.!~
Yu Myung-Han (유명한) is Jin-Ho's father and the CEO of Yoojin Construction.

Reiji Sugimoto is the Vice-Master of Draw Sword Guild, the second most powerful guild in Asia.

During the 4th Jeju Island Reclamation Raid, Reiji Sugimoto did not directly participate in the raid like his guild master Goto Ryuji. However, he was onboard the second DDH-184, one of the numerous Japanese boats surrounding the island.
King of Demons and the Monarch of White Flames.
Kenzo Tanaka is a Japanese S-Rank Hunter who specialized in melee combat and a member of the Draw Sword Guild.
Sangmin Ahn is the chief of the White Tiger Guild's 2nd Division Management Department.

Kei (케이) was one of Japan's strongest S-Rank Hunters who was a member of the Draw Sword Guild, the strongest guild in japan led by Goto Ryuji.

He was a powerful mage class hunter specializing in ice magic.

Sang-Sik Kim is a Korean D-Rank Hunter. ~!He was a survivor of the Double Dungeon. He was tragically killed by [Tae-Shik Kang](https://anilist.co/character/181155/TaeShik-Kang) after accidentally witnessing him kill a man during a raid.!~
Kichul Hyun is the deputy manager of the White Tiger Guild's 2nd Division Management Department and Sangimn Ahn's assistant.
Michael Connor is the Deputy Director of the Federal Bureau of Hunters.
Jongsoo Park is a Korean A-Rank Hunter and the Guild Master of the Knights Guild.
King of Beasts and the Monarch of Fangs.
Tae-Gyu Lim is a Korean S-Rank hunter who specializes in archery magic and the Guild Master of the Fiend Guild.
Yoontae Jung is a Korean A-Rank Hunter under the Knights Guild.
Shigeo Matsumoto was the Chairman of the Japanese Hunters Association.
Myung-Hwan Go is a Korean C-Rank Hunter under the White Tiger Guild.
Tatsumi Fujishima is a Japanese S-Rank Hunter and a member of the Draw Sword Guild.
Lee Seong-Chul is the Director of the Ilsin Hospital, the hospital where [Kyung-Hye Park](https://anilist.co/character/209396/KyungHye-Park) stayed at while she was ill with Eternal Slumber.
Kijoong Yoon is a Korean C-Rank Hunter under the White Tiger Guild. ~!He is one of the five survivors of the Red Gate Incident.!~
S-Ranked magic beast. Vulcan was the second boss of the Demon Castle and the Ruler of the Lower Floors.
Leader of the Hunters Guild's Mining Team.
Korean Hunter serving under the Hunters Guild, assigned to Strike Squad B.
King of Snow Folk and the Monarch of Frost.
Pro Hunter working for the Hunters Guild. He is on Strike Team B.
Korean B-Rank Hunter serving under the Hunters Guild, assigned to Strike Squad B.
